blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawyer Sheila Sison, Vice President Sara Duterte’s lead lawyer in the impeachment trial, has questioned the prosecution panel for asking them to adjust — to allow the presentation of a forensic financial analyst instead of the originally scheduled witness — when it was a private prosecutor who got sick. Sison, during the resumption of Duterte’s trial on Thursday, said that it would be unfair if Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero went on with his decision to allow the prosecution to first present financial forensic analyst Atty.
